story_summary: On a city rooftop at sunset, a frustrated young dreamer confronts his pain and self-doubt. He channels every hardship into a source of power, transforming his struggle into an unbreakable creative fire and emerging as a confident believer in his own strength.

characters.name: The Dreamer
characters.visual_design: A determined young man with expressive anime eyes, wearing a dark grey knit beanie, a simple black hoodie, and worn jeans.

story_beats.title: The Breaking Point
story_beats.description: Fired up and tired of the way things have been, The Dreamer stands at the edge of a rooftop, clenching his fists in frustration against the world.

story_beats.title: Let Them Rain
story_beats.description: He looks up defiantly as metaphorical 'bullets'—shards of negativity and hardship—rain down upon him, but he refuses to break.

story_beats.title: The Believer
story_beats.description: Unleashing a primal scream, The Dreamer explodes with power. A fiery aura of creative energy erupts from him, shattering the negativity into dust.

story_beats.title: Creative Fire
story_beats.description: Now calm and resolute, The Dreamer stands silhouetted against the sunset, golden embers of inspiration rising from his hands into the crimson sky.

panels.caption: First things first, I'ma say all the words inside my head...
I'm fired up and tired of the way that things have been...
PAIN! You made me a, you made me a BELIEVER!
Let the bullets fly, let them rain...
